zh.q: 什么东西越洗越脏?
zh.hint: 想想你洗手的时候,是什么变脏了?

zh.q: 什么东西有四条腿,却从来不会自己走路?
zh.hint: 吃饭和写作业的时候,你常常会用到它。

zh.q: 什么东西有五个手指,却不是真的手?
zh.hint: 冬天天气冷的时候,你会把它戴上。

zh.q: 什么东西越用越小,还能把你洗得香香的?
zh.hint: 洗手的时候,它会搓出很多泡泡。

zh.q: 什么门永远关不上?
zh.hint: 踢足球的时候,大家都想把球踢进去。

zh.q: 什么东西有一只眼睛,却什么也看不见?
zh.hint: 妈妈缝衣服的时候会用到它,线要穿过它的小洞。

zh.q: 什么动物的耳朵长长的,爱吃胡萝卜,跑起来一蹦一跳?
zh.hint: 它的尾巴短短的,像一个小棉球。

zh.q: 什么东西你喊它,它就会学你说话,可是你看不到它?
zh.hint: 在山谷里或者空空的大房间里喊一声,试试看。

zh.q: 什么东西飞得很高,线却在你手里?
zh.hint: 春天的时候,大家喜欢到草地上放它。

zh.q: 什么东西外面白白的,里面黄黄的,敲开才能吃?
zh.hint: 早餐的时候,爸爸妈妈常常会给你煮一个。

zh.q: 麻屋子,红帐子,里面住着白胖子,是什么?
zh.hint: 它长在土里面,剥开壳就可以吃。

zh.q: 什么水果又圆又脆,有红的也有绿的,天天吃一个对身体好?
zh.hint: 你咬一口的时候,会发出咔嚓的声音。

zh.q: 什么东西晚上出来,有时弯弯像小船,有时圆圆像盘子?
zh.hint: 中秋节的时候,大家会一起抬头看它。

zh.q: 什么东西夜晚挂满天空,像一闪一闪的小眼睛?
zh.hint: 晚上抬头看天空,它们像撒了一地的小钻石。

zh.q: 什么东西没有脚,却一直在跑,最后跑进大海?
zh.hint: 它弯弯曲曲,里面有小鱼在游。

zh.q: 什么东西有牙齿,却从来不吃东西?
zh.hint: 早上起床后,妈妈用它把你的头发理整齐。

zh.q: 什么东西夏天最受欢迎,放在太阳下就会流眼泪?
zh.hint: 它冰冰凉凉,甜甜的,要快点吃。

zh.q: 什么东西专门帮你擦掉写错的字,自己却越用越小?
zh.hint: 它常常躺在你的文具盒里。

zh.q: 什么东西只要你一说话,它就不见了?
zh.hint: 图书馆里的人,都希望有很多这个。

zh.q: 什么东西白天挂在天上,又圆又亮,给大地送来温暖?
zh.hint: 它每天早上从东边升起来。

zh.q: 什么花不用浇水,只在夜空里开一小会儿,还会砰砰响?
zh.hint: 过年的时候,大家会一起抬头看它。

zh.q: 什么东西有很多页,里面住着许多故事,却从来不会说话?
zh.hint: 睡觉前,爸爸妈妈会翻开它读给你听。

zh.q: 什么东西下雨时就开花,雨停了就合起来?
zh.hint: 出门遇到下雨,你可以把它举在头上。

zh.q: 什么动物有黑眼圈,身体胖胖的,最爱吃竹子?
zh.hint: 它是中国的国宝,住在四川的山里。

zh.q: 什么动物脖子最长,能吃到树顶上的叶子?
zh.hint: 它身上有一块一块的花纹,个子非常高。

zh.q: 什么小动物走得慢吞吞,还背着自己的房子?
zh.hint: 下雨以后,它常常爬到叶子上,头上有两只小触角。

zh.q: 龟兔赛跑的故事里,最后赢得比赛的是谁?
zh.hint: 它虽然走得很慢,但是一直没有停下来。

zh.q: 什么动物小时候有尾巴,长大后尾巴不见了,还会呱呱叫?
zh.hint: 它喜欢住在池塘边,会一蹦一跳。

zh.q: 什么鸟住在冰天雪地里,走路摇摇摆摆,却不会飞?
zh.hint: 它穿着黑白相间的衣服,像个小绅士。

zh.q: 什么昆虫小时候是毛毛虫,长大后穿着花衣服飞来飞去?
zh.hint: 它常常停在花朵上。

zh.q: 什么小虫夏天夜里,提着小灯笼飞来飞去?
zh.hint: 它的尾巴会一闪一闪地发光。

zh.q: 什么小昆虫天天忙着采花,还会酿出甜甜的东西?
zh.hint: 它嗡嗡嗡地飞,做出来的东西可以涂在面包上。

zh.q: 什么小虫吃桑叶,吐出细细的丝,丝可以做漂亮的衣服?
zh.hint: 它的丝很长很长,可以织成软软的布。

zh.q: 什么动物鼻子最长,耳朵像大扇子,身体像一座小山?
zh.hint: 它用长长的鼻子喝水,还能给自己洗澡。

zh.q: 什么动物爱吃桃子,爬树又快又灵活,长得有点像人?
zh.hint: 孙悟空和它是同一类。

zh.q: 什么动物每天早上喔喔喔,叫大家起床?
zh.hint: 它头上戴着一顶红红的帽子。

zh.q: 什么动物会看家,见到主人就摇尾巴?
zh.hint: 它的叫声很响,还喜欢和你一起玩球。

zh.q: 什么动物胡子翘翘,爱晒太阳,走路没有声音,还会捉老鼠?
zh.hint: 它爱用舌头舔自己的毛,把自己洗得干干净净。

zh.q: 什么动物一辈子住在水里,不会说话,只会吐泡泡?
zh.hint: 它用尾巴和鳍游来游去。

zh.q: 什么东西你走它也走,你停它也停,可是你永远摸不到它?
zh.hint: 在太阳底下,它总是跟在你的脚边。

zh.q: 什么东西你笑它也笑,你做鬼脸它也做鬼脸,可是从来不说话?
zh.hint: 每天早上刷牙的时候,你都会看到它。

zh.q: 什么东西没有腿,却会滴答滴答地一直走?
zh.hint: 它告诉你什么时候该起床,什么时候该吃饭。

zh.q: 什么东西穿着木头衣服,肚子里有黑黑的芯,专门用来写字?
zh.hint: 写错了的时候,你需要另一样东西来帮忙。

zh.q: 什么东西从天上掉下来,滴滴答答,花草树木最爱它?
zh.hint: 它落在地上,会变成一个一个小水坑。

zh.q: 什么东西有时像棉花,有时像小羊,在天上慢慢飘?
zh.hint: 下雨之前,天上常常有很多灰色的它。

zh.q: 什么东西雨后挂在天上,像一座七彩的大桥?
zh.hint: 它有红橙黄绿青蓝紫,一共七种颜色。

zh.q: 什么东西你看不见,可是它能让树叶沙沙响,让你的头发飘起来?
zh.hint: 夏天的时候,它吹在脸上很凉快。

zh.q: 什么东西冬天从天上飘下来,白白软软,落在手心里就化了?
zh.hint: 冬天下得很多的时候,你可以在外面堆一个胖胖的人。

zh.q: 什么东西天天早晚在你嘴巴里跳舞,让牙齿干干净净?
zh.hint: 你要先挤一点牙膏在它上面。

zh.q: 什么东西兄弟两个一样长,吃饭时总是一起上?
zh.hint: 我们吃面条的时候要用它。

zh.q: 什么东西两个刀片连在一起,咔嚓咔嚓地剪纸?
zh.hint: 做手工的时候,你一定会用到它。

zh.q: 什么东西一头有小齿,专门给门开锁?
zh.hint: 回到家的时候,爸爸妈妈会用它开门。

zh.q: 什么东西一按开关,黑夜就变得亮亮的?
zh.hint: 睡觉前,你把它关上,房间就暗了。

zh.q: 什么东西天天陪你走路,却总是被你踩在脚下?
zh.hint: 出门前,你要把它穿好。

zh.q: 什么东西闭上才能睡觉,睁开才能看见世界?
zh.hint: 它长在你的脸上,一共有两个。

zh.q: 什么东西长在头的两边,专门用来听声音?
zh.hint: 听音乐,听故事,都要靠它。

zh.q: 什么东西有五个兄弟,能拿东西,也能拍起来啪啪响?
zh.hint: 吃饭前,要先把它洗干净。

zh.q: 什么水果外面绿衣裳,里面红沙瓤,夏天吃了最凉快?
zh.hint: 它圆滚滚的,里面有很多黑色的籽。

zh.q: 什么水果弯弯的,剥掉黄色的皮,里面是软软的白肉?
zh.hint: 它一串一串地长在树上。

zh.q: 什么东西上面插着蜡烛,你吹灭蜡烛之前要先许个愿?
zh.hint: 一年只有一次,大家会围着你唱歌。

zh.q: 一口咬掉牛尾巴,打一个字。
zh.hint: 牛字去掉下面的尾巴,上面再加一个口。

zh.q: 一人一张口,口下长只手,打一个字。
zh.hint: 上面是合起来的合,下面是一只手。

zh.q: 两个人坐在土堆上,打一个字。
zh.hint: 答案就藏在题目里,两个人加一个土。

zh.q: 大口吃小口,打一个字。
zh.hint: 一个大口里面套着一个小口。

zh.q: 一个人,他姓王,口袋里装着两块糖,打一个字。
zh.hint: 人字头,下面一个王,两点就是糖。

zh.q: 上边毛,下边毛,中间一颗黑葡萄,打一个身体部位。
zh.hint: 上下的毛是睫毛。

zh.q: 千里相逢,打一个字。
zh.hint: 把千和里叠在一起。

zh.q: 王大娘,白大娘,一起坐在石头上,打一个字。
zh.hint: 王、白、石三个字合在一起。

zh.q: 日月同辉,打一个字。
zh.hint: 一边是日,一边是月。

zh.q: 人在木旁,打一个字。
zh.hint: 一个人靠着大树歇一歇。

zh.q: 三人同日去看花,打一个字。
zh.hint: 上面是三和人,下面一个日。

zh.q: 十张口,一颗心,打一个字。
zh.hint: 十和口合成一个田,下面加一颗心。

zh.q: 木字下面一个子,打一个字。
zh.hint: 是一种水果,也是一个常见的姓。

zh.q: 鸟字下面换成山,打一个字。
zh.hint: 大海中间的一块陆地。

zh.q: 门里有个口,打一个字。
zh.hint: 门里有口,就要开口问。

zh.q: 门里有个日,打一个字。
zh.hint: 门里藏着一个太阳。

zh.q: 门里有匹马,打一个字。
zh.hint: 一匹马冲进门里。

zh.q: 半个月亮,打一个字。
zh.hint: 月字旁边加一个半。

zh.q: 一口咬住多半截,打一个字。
zh.hint: 多字只留上面的夕,下面加一个口。

zh.q: 两棵树站在一起,打一个字。
zh.hint: 两个木字并排站。

zh.q: 三棵树站在一起,打一个字。
zh.hint: 三个木字叠起来。

zh.q: 三个太阳叠起来,打一个字。
zh.hint: 三个日字叠在一起。

zh.q: 三张嘴叠起来,打一个字。
zh.hint: 三个口字叠在一起。

zh.q: 三个人站在一起,打一个字。
zh.hint: 三个人字叠起来。

zh.q: 三块石头叠起来,打一个字。
zh.hint: 三个石字叠在一起。

zh.q: 一人一口,打一个字。
zh.hint: 人字头下面一横,再加一个口。

zh.q: 左边一个女,右边一个子,打一个字。
zh.hint: 女孩和男孩在一起。

zh.q: 上面小,下面大,打一个字。
zh.hint: 小字在上,大字在下。

zh.q: 有水能养鱼虾,有土能种庄稼,有人不是你我,有马走遍天下,打一个字。
zh.hint: 加三点水是池,加土是地,加人是他。

zh.q: 一块地分成四个格子,打一个字。
zh.hint: 种庄稼的地方。

zh.q: 什么东西天越热,你身上冒出来的越多?
zh.hint: 跑步跑得很热的时候,身上会冒出来。

zh.q: 什么东西有头没有脚,一敲就往木头里钻?
zh.hint: 要用锤子敲它。

zh.q: 什么东西白白一小根,在黑板上越写越短?
zh.hint: 老师上课的时候常用它。

zh.q: 什么东西身上全是小洞,却能吸住很多水?
zh.hint: 洗碗或者洗澡时会用到它。

zh.q: 什么动物穿着黑白条纹的衣服,长得像马?
zh.hint: 它住在非洲大草原。

zh.q: 什么动物咩咩叫,身上的毛可以织毛衣?
zh.hint: 它爱吃青草。

zh.q: 什么动物一害怕就把自己缩成一个刺球?
zh.hint: 它背上长满尖尖的刺。

zh.q: 什么动物背上有驼峰,能在沙漠里走很久?
zh.hint: 它被叫作沙漠之舟。

zh.q: 什么动物肚子上有个口袋,可以装小宝宝?
zh.hint: 它住在澳大利亚,跳得特别远。

zh.q: 什么动物白天倒挂着睡觉,晚上出来飞?
zh.hint: 它会飞,可它不是鸟。

zh.q: 什么动物有八条腿,住在海里,还会喷墨汁?
zh.hint: 它的腿上有很多小吸盘。

zh.q: 什么动物横着走路,还举着两把大钳子?
zh.hint: 它住在海边的沙滩上。

zh.q: 什么动物住在海里,比大象还大,还会从头顶喷水?
zh.hint: 它是世界上最大的动物。

zh.q: 什么动物额头上像写着一个王字,被叫作森林之王?
zh.hint: 它身上有黑黄的条纹。

zh.q: 什么动物会大声吼,爸爸头上有一圈长长的鬃毛?
zh.hint: 它被叫作草原之王。

zh.q: 什么鸟会学人说话?
zh.hint: 它的羽毛颜色很鲜艳。

zh.q: 什么鸟的尾巴展开像一把彩色的大扇子?
zh.hint: 开屏的时候特别漂亮。

zh.q: 什么小动物尾巴毛茸茸的,爱吃松果,会把果子藏起来过冬?
zh.hint: 它住在树上,跳来跳去。

zh.q: 什么动物会织网,用网捉小虫子?
zh.hint: 它有八条腿。

zh.q: 什么小虫能搬比自己大的东西,还排着队走路?
zh.hint: 它们住在地下的小洞里。

zh.q: 什么动物身体长长的,没有脚,却会爬?
zh.hint: 它会嘶嘶地吐舌头。

zh.q: 什么动物哼哼叫,吃饱了就睡,鼻子圆圆的?
zh.hint: 小猪佩奇就是它。

zh.q: 什么动物跑得很快,人可以骑在它背上?
zh.hint: 它跑起来嗒嗒嗒。

zh.q: 什么水果穿着毛毛的外衣,里面是绿色的?
zh.hint: 切开里面有一圈小黑籽。

zh.q: 什么水果一串一串的,圆圆的,有紫的也有绿的?
zh.hint: 晒干了会变成葡萄干。

zh.q: 什么水果头上戴着绿帽子,身上长满小芝麻?
zh.hint: 红红的,酸酸甜甜。

zh.q: 什么水果黄黄的,特别酸,吃一口会眯起眼睛?
zh.hint: 人们常把它切片泡水喝。

zh.q: 什么水果剥开外皮,里面是一瓣一瓣的?
zh.hint: 它的颜色和名字差不多。

zh.q: 什么东西长在土里,红红长长的,兔子最爱吃?
zh.hint: 它的名字里有萝卜两个字。

zh.q: 什么蔬菜切开的时候,会让人流眼泪?
zh.hint: 它一层一层剥不完。

zh.q: 什么蔬菜圆圆红红的,既能当水果吃,又能炒鸡蛋?
zh.hint: 它红红的,有点酸。

zh.q: 什么东西放进锅里一加热,就砰砰砰变成白白的花?
zh.hint: 看电影的时候常吃它。

zh.q: 什么东西冷冰冰的,放进杯子里能让饮料变凉?
zh.hint: 放久了会化成水。

zh.q: 什么东西夏天转啊转,给你送来凉风?
zh.hint: 它有几片会转的叶子。

zh.q: 什么东西在天上一闪一闪,接着就轰隆隆响?
zh.hint: 下大雨的时候常出现。

zh.q: 什么东西早上挂在草叶上,一颗颗亮晶晶,太阳一出来就不见了?
zh.hint: 它是一小滴水。

zh.q: 什么东西冬天挂在屋檐下,尖尖的,像透明的胡萝卜?
zh.hint: 它是水结成的冰。

zh.q: 什么东西像个大圆球,我们所有人都住在它上面?
zh.hint: 从太空看它是蓝色的。

zh.q: 什么东西圆圆的能转,上面画着全世界的国家?
zh.hint: 它是地球的小模型。

zh.q: 什么东西有两个轮子,要用脚踩着才能走?
zh.hint: 它有车铃,叮铃铃。

zh.q: 什么东西长长的一节一节,在铁轨上跑?
zh.hint: 它会鸣笛呜呜呜。

zh.q: 什么东西有翅膀不会扇,却能带着很多人飞上天?
zh.hint: 它在机场起飞。

zh.q: 什么东西在水上走,能装很多人和货物?
zh.hint: 它停在码头。

zh.q: 什么车一路叫着呜哇呜哇,哪里着火去哪里?
zh.hint: 车身是红色的。

zh.q: 什么东西四四方方,一按遥控器就能看动画片?
zh.hint: 它挂在客厅的墙上。

zh.q: 什么东西肚子里冷冷的,放着牛奶和水果?
zh.hint: 它在厨房里。

zh.q: 什么东西一页一页撕掉,撕完一年就过完了?
zh.hint: 它告诉你今天几号。

zh.q: 什么东西你越喂它,它越重,里面装的全是钱?
zh.hint: 它常常长得像一只小猪。

zh.q: 什么东西装满了水,小鱼在里面游来游去,放在家里?
zh.hint: 它常常是玻璃做的。

zh.q: 什么东西有很多颜色,能在纸上画出彩虹?
zh.hint: 画画的时候要用它。

zh.q: 什么东西白天叠起来,晚上盖在你身上暖暖的?
zh.hint: 它在床上。

zh.q: 什么东西天冷的时候围在脖子上?
zh.hint: 它是长长软软的。

zh.q: 什么东西戴在头上,冬天保暖,夏天遮太阳?
zh.hint: 出门前可以戴上它。

zh.q: 什么东西有两个镜片,架在鼻子上帮人看清楚?
zh.hint: 看不清字的人会戴它。

zh.q: 什么东西圆圆的,里面装着空气,大家追着用脚踢?
zh.hint: 踢进球门就得分。

zh.q: 什么东西两头有手柄,中间一根绳,甩起来呼呼转?
zh.hint: 体育课上常用它。

zh.q: 什么东西你坐上去,一推就前后荡来荡去?
zh.hint: 公园里常常有它。

zh.q: 什么东西上去要爬楼梯,下来哧溜一下就到底?
zh.hint: 游乐场里最受欢迎。

zh.q: 什么东西有很多小块,拼来拼去能拼出一幅画?
zh.hint: 先找四个角最容易。

zh.q: 什么东西有很多黑白的键,弹起来叮叮咚咚?
zh.hint: 它是一种很大的乐器。

zh.q: 什么东西不吃饭,只喝墨水,喝饱了就能写字?
zh.hint: 它和铅笔不一样,写的字擦不掉。

zh.q: 什么东西背在背上,里面装着课本和文具?
zh.hint: 上学的时候要带着它。

zh.q: 什么东西是你的,可是别人用得比你多?
zh.hint: 大家叫你的时候就要用它。

zh.q: 什么人一年只在一个晚上工作,爬烟囱给小朋友送礼物?
zh.hint: 他穿红衣服,有白胡子。

zh.q: 什么节日要吃月饼,一家人一起看圆圆的月亮?
zh.hint: 它在秋天。

zh.q: 什么节日要贴春联、放鞭炮、拿红包?
zh.hint: 它是中国最热闹的节日。

zh.q: 什么节日要吃粽子,还要划龙舟?
zh.hint: 它在夏天。

zh.q: 什么东西春天长出来,夏天绿油油,秋天变黄掉下来?
zh.hint: 它长在树枝上。

zh.q: 什么东西在锅里咕嘟咕嘟冒泡,还冒出白白的气?
zh.hint: 烧开以后才能喝。

zh.q: 什么东西黑黑的,天一黑就来,天一亮就走?
zh.hint: 它来了,月亮和星星就出来了。

en.q: What has hands but cannot clap?
en.hint: It helps you know what time it is.

en.q: What has keys but cannot open a door?
en.hint: You press them to make music.

en.q: What has cities, roads, and mountains, but nobody lives in it?
en.hint: You can look at it to find your way.

en.q: What has to be cracked before you can use it?
en.hint: You might have it for breakfast.

en.q: What gets wetter the more it dries?
en.hint: You use it after a bath.

en.q: What is full of holes but still soaks up water?
en.hint: You might use it to wash the dishes.

en.q: What has four legs but cannot walk?
en.hint: You eat your dinner at it.

en.q: What has an eye but cannot see?
en.hint: A thread goes through its tiny hole.

en.q: What follows you all day but disappears in the dark?
en.hint: It stretches long when the sun is low.

en.q: What repeats whatever you shout in a canyon or a big empty hall?
en.hint: Try shouting in the mountains.

en.q: What gets smaller as it glows on a birthday cake?
en.hint: You blow it out after making a wish.

en.q: What has a pointy tip and a little rubber hat, and helps you write?
en.hint: You sharpen it when the tip gets dull.

en.q: What makes mistakes disappear but gets smaller every time you use it?
en.hint: You use it when you write the wrong word.

en.q: What has a spine and pages, but no bones and no legs?
en.hint: You read it before bed.

en.q: What has a mouth but never eats, and a bed but never sleeps?
en.hint: It flows all the way to the sea.

en.q: What shines at night, changes its shape, and has no feet?
en.hint: Sometimes it is thin and curved, and sometimes it is big and round.

en.q: What rises every morning, warms the world, and goes to bed at night?
en.hint: It gives us daylight.

en.q: What twinkles in the night sky like a tiny diamond?
en.hint: You can make a wish on the first one you see.

en.q: What floats in the sky and looks like fluffy cotton?
en.hint: Sometimes it looks like an animal.

en.q: What falls from the clouds and fills up the puddles?
en.hint: You need boots when there is a lot of it.

en.q: What has seven colors and shows up after a rainy day?
en.hint: It makes a big colorful arch across the sky.

en.q: What is white and cold, falls in winter, and melts in your hand?
en.hint: You can make angels or a big round man with it.

en.q: What can push a sailboat and rustle the leaves, but can never be seen?
en.hint: You feel it on your face on a blowy day.

en.q: What flies high in the sky but has no wings, and you hold its string?
en.hint: People fly it on a windy day.

en.q: What gets bigger when you blow into it, and goes pop if you add too much?
en.hint: You often see it at a birthday party.

en.q: What opens up when it rains and keeps you dry?
en.hint: You hold it over your head on a wet day.

en.q: What copies everything you do but never says a word?
en.hint: You can see your own face in it.

en.q: What comes in a pair, hides inside your shoes, and keeps your toes warm?
en.hint: You put them on before your shoes.

en.q: What has five fingers but is not alive?
en.hint: You wear it on a cold day.

en.q: What has bristles and makes your teeth clean?
en.hint: You use it every morning and every night with paste.

en.q: What has teeth but cannot bite?
en.hint: It makes your hair neat.

en.q: What has teeth, goes up and down, and keeps your jacket closed?
en.hint: You pull a tiny tab to make it move.

en.q: What can open a lock but is not a hand?
en.hint: It is small and often hangs on a ring.

en.q: What makes a ding-dong sound when you pull its rope or tap it?
en.hint: A school has one to tell you when class is over.

en.q: What lets you talk to grandma far away even though it has no mouth?
en.hint: It rings when someone calls you.

en.q: What sticks to an envelope and travels all around the world?
en.hint: You need it to mail a letter.

en.q: What is cold and sweet and melts if you wait too long on a hot day?
en.hint: It comes in a cone or a cup.

en.q: What is yellow and curved, and you peel it before you eat it?
en.hint: It grows in a bunch.

en.q: What fruit is said to keep the doctor away if you eat one every day?
en.hint: It can be red or green and makes a crunch.

en.q: What has ears but cannot hear?
en.hint: It grows on a tall stalk in a farm field.

en.q: What is green outside, red inside, and full of black seeds?
en.hint: It is a big juicy fruit for summer picnics.

en.q: What grows under the ground and can be mashed or turned into fries?
en.hint: It is a brown, lumpy vegetable.

en.q: What is big and orange, and can become a pie or a lantern?
en.hint: It grows on a vine and is popular in autumn.

en.q: What buzzes from flower to flower and makes sweet honey?
en.hint: It has yellow and black stripes.

en.q: What starts as a caterpillar, sleeps in a cocoon, then flies away with colorful wings?
en.hint: It sips from flowers.

en.q: What starts as a tadpole and grows up to jump and say ribbit?
en.hint: It likes to sit on a lily pad.

en.q: What gives us milk and says moo?
en.hint: It lives on a farm and eats grass.

en.q: What waddles, says quack, and loves to swim in a pond?
en.hint: It has a flat orange bill.

en.q: What animal has a trunk, big floppy ears, and is the largest on land?
en.hint: It sprays water with its long nose.

en.q: What animal has the longest neck and eats leaves from tall trees?
en.hint: It has spots and is very tall.

en.q: What black and white bird can swim but cannot fly?
en.hint: It lives where it is icy and it waddles.

en.q: What bird says hoo-hoo and stays awake at night?
en.hint: It has big round eyes and is said to be wise.

en.q: What carries its house on its back and moves very slowly?
en.hint: It leaves a shiny trail behind it.

en.q: What slow animal has a hard shell and won a famous race against a rabbit?
en.hint: In the story, it never gave up.

en.q: What has fins and scales and lives underwater but cannot talk?
en.hint: It breathes with gills.

en.q: What wags its tail when it is happy and is called our best friend?
en.hint: It barks and loves to play fetch.

en.q: What has whiskers, purrs, and loves to chase a ball of yarn?
en.hint: It likes to nap in sunny spots.

en.q: What has a bottom at the top?
en.hint: You use them for running and jumping.

en.q: What has a head and a foot but no body, and you sleep in it?
en.hint: It has a soft pillow and blankets.

en.q: What begins with T, ends with T, and is full of tea?
en.hint: It pours a warm drink at a tea party.

en.q: What goes up but never comes down?
en.hint: It changes on your birthday.

en.q: What can you catch but not throw?
en.hint: Achoo!

en.q: What has a neck but no head?
en.hint: You drink juice or water out of it.

en.q: What belongs to you, but other people use it more than you do?
en.hint: People say it when they call you.

en.q: What goes through towns and fields but never moves?
en.hint: Cars drive on it.

en.q: What can you hold in your right hand but never in your left hand?
en.hint: Think about your own two hands.

en.q: What kind of room has no doors and no windows?
en.hint: It grows in the forest after the rain.

en.q: What has four wheels and flies?
en.hint: Flies are little bugs that love smelly trash.

en.q: What do you call a bear with no teeth?
en.hint: It's a chewy candy.

en.q: What month of the year has 28 days?
en.hint: Every month has at least 28 days.

en.q: What is so fragile that saying its name breaks it?
en.hint: Shhh...

en.q: What can fill a room but takes up no space?
en.hint: You turn it on with a switch.

en.q: What starts with E, ends with E, and has only one letter in it?
en.hint: You put a letter inside and mail it.

en.q: What gets bigger the more you take away from it?
en.hint: You dig it in the sand with a shovel.

en.q: What can you break without touching it?
en.hint: You make it when you say I promise.

en.q: What has lots of eyes but cannot see?
en.hint: Its eyes are little spots where it sprouts.

en.q: What is orange and sounds like a parrot?
en.hint: Rabbits love to munch it.

en.q: What has bark but never barks?
en.hint: It has leaves and branches.

en.q: What animal can jump higher than a house?
en.hint: Can a house jump at all?

en.q: What has a head and a tail but no body?
en.hint: You can flip it.

en.q: What kind of tree can you carry in your hand?
en.hint: Look at the inside of your hand.

en.q: What is easy to get into but hard to get out of?
en.hint: Grown-ups say: you'll get into it if you are naughty!

en.q: What do you call a dinosaur that is sleeping?
en.hint: Listen to the sound it makes when it sleeps.

en.q: What is always coming but never arrives?
en.hint: When it comes, it becomes today.

en.q: What can you hear but cannot see or touch?
en.hint: You use it to sing and talk.

en.q: What is white when it is dirty and black when it is clean?
en.hint: Teachers write on it with chalk.

en.q: Which is heavier, a pound of feathers or a pound of rocks?
en.hint: A pound is a pound.

en.q: What has four legs and a back, but you sit on it and it never walks?
en.hint: It is not a table.

en.q: What kind of coat can you only put on when it is wet?
en.hint: You put it on with a brush.

en.q: What has two wheels and pedals and you ride it to the park?
en.hint: You ring its little bell.

en.q: I have wings and a beak, I lay eggs, and I say cluck. What am I?
en.hint: My babies are called chicks.

en.q: I have black and white stripes, I live in Africa, and I look like a horse. What am I?
en.hint: Nobody can paint my stripes, I was born with them.

en.q: I am big and gray and I have a horn on my nose. What am I?
en.hint: My skin is thick like armor.

en.q: I hop, I have a pouch, and I live in Australia. What am I?
en.hint: My baby is called a joey.

en.q: I am the king of the jungle and I roar. What am I?
en.hint: I have a big furry mane.

en.q: I have eight arms and I live in the sea. What am I?
en.hint: I can squirt ink.

en.q: I sleep upside down all day and fly at night. What am I?
en.hint: I have wings, but I am not a bird.

en.q: I am black and white and I eat bamboo all day. What am I?
en.hint: I come from China.

en.q: I swing from trees, I have a long tail, and I love bananas. What am I?
en.hint: I go ooh ooh aah aah.

en.q: I have a hard shell and two pinchers, and I walk sideways. What am I?
en.hint: You find me at the beach.

en.q: I am the biggest animal in the ocean. What am I?
en.hint: I spray water out of my blowhole.

en.q: I spin a web to catch flies. What am I?
en.hint: I have eight legs.

en.q: I have sharp quills on my back to keep me safe. What am I?
en.hint: Don't touch my spikes!

en.q: I light up and fly around on summer nights. What am I?
en.hint: My tail glows in the dark.

en.q: I am a fruit that grows in bunches, purple or green. What am I?
en.hint: When I dry up, I become raisins.

en.q: I am red and I wear my seeds on the outside. What am I?
en.hint: I wear a little green hat.

en.q: I am yellow and so sour that I make your face pucker. What am I?
en.hint: My juice goes into a famous summer drink.

en.q: I am a vegetable that makes you cry when you cut me. What am I?
en.hint: I have many layers.

en.q: I pop when you heat me, and people eat me at the movies. What am I?
en.hint: I start as a little corn kernel.

en.q: I am made of snow and I have a carrot nose. What am I?
en.hint: You build me in winter.

en.q: I make a loud boom during a storm. What am I?
en.hint: I come right after the lightning.

en.q: I spin around and keep you cool on a hot day. What am I?
en.hint: I have blades that go around.

en.q: I keep your food cold in the kitchen. What am I?
en.hint: Milk and juice live inside me.

en.q: I have a screen and you watch cartoons on me. What am I?
en.hint: You change my channels with a remote.

en.q: I have a page for every day and you flip me each month. What am I?
en.hint: I tell you the date.

en.q: I am a little house for coins with a slot on top. What am I?
en.hint: I often look like a little pig.

en.q: I fly high in the sky and carry lots of people. What am I?
en.hint: I take off from an airport.

en.q: I run on tracks and say choo-choo. What am I?
en.hint: I pull many cars in a line.

en.q: I float on the water and carry people across the sea. What am I?
en.hint: I might have a sail.

en.q: I have a loud siren and I rush to put out fires. What am I?
en.hint: Firefighters ride on me.

en.q: I am round, people kick me, and they try to score goals with me. What am I?
en.hint: Players chase me across a field.

en.q: I go back and forth in the park and you sit on me. What am I?
en.hint: Pump your legs to go higher!

en.q: I have lots of pieces that fit together to make a picture. What am I?
en.hint: Find the corner pieces first.

en.q: I am a bag you carry on your back to school. What am I?
en.hint: Your books and lunch go inside.

en.q: I keep your neck warm in winter. What am I?
en.hint: You wrap me around.

en.q: I sit on your nose and help you see. What am I?
en.hint: I have two lenses.

en.q: I come on your birthday with wrapping paper and a bow. What am I?
en.hint: You open me to find a surprise.

en.q: I am the holiday when you dress up and say trick or treat. What am I?
en.hint: Pumpkins and costumes!

en.q: I am a round sweet treat with a hole in the middle. What am I?
en.hint: I am often covered in sprinkles.

en.q: You chew me and blow me into a bubble. What am I?
en.hint: Chew me, but don't swallow me!

en.q: What has a head like a cat, feet like a cat, and a tail like a cat, but is not a cat?
en.hint: It is a baby.

en.q: What has many needles but never sews?
en.hint: It stays green all winter.

en.q: What is as big as an elephant but weighs nothing at all?
en.hint: It appears when the sun shines on the elephant.

en.q: What goes up and down but never moves?
en.hint: You climb them to go upstairs.

en.q: What can you make but never see?
en.hint: Banging on a drum makes a lot of it.

en.q: Where does Friday come before Thursday?
en.hint: Think about the alphabet.

en.q: What is light as a feather, but even the strongest person cannot hold it for long?
en.hint: Breathe in and try to hold it.

en.q: What goes all the way around the yard but never moves?
en.hint: It keeps the dog inside the yard.

en.q: What has a big mouth that never talks, and you put trash in it?
en.hint: Its lid goes up and down.

en.q: What can be told, made, cracked and played?
en.hint: It makes people laugh.

en.q: What kind of band never plays any music?
en.hint: It is stretchy.

en.q: What sticky, sweet food do bees make?
en.hint: Bears love it too.

en.q: What is made of water, but dies if you put it in water?
en.hint: It melts.

en.q: What do you call a snowman in the summer?
en.hint: The sun melts him.

en.q: What kind of dog always knows what time it is?
en.hint: A watch tells time.

en.q: Why was six afraid of seven?
en.hint: Say the numbers out loud: seven, eight, nine.

en.q: What has three feet but cannot walk?
en.hint: A yard is three feet long.

en.q: What is at the end of a rainbow?
en.hint: Look at how the word rainbow is spelled.

en.q: What has a lid, holds soup, and sits on the stove?
en.hint: You cook in it.

en.q: What has keys and a screen and helps you type?
en.hint: Grown-ups often use it at work.

en.q: What wears a coat all winter and pants all summer?
en.hint: It has a furry coat and pants when it is hot.

en.q: What has a tongue but cannot taste?
en.hint: You tie its laces.

en.q: What has a crown, is not a king, and you brush it twice a day?
en.hint: It lives in your mouth.

en.q: What is bought by the yard and worn by the foot?
en.hint: It covers the floor.

en.q: What do you tie into a bow to keep your shoes on?
en.hint: You learn to tie them.

en.q: What can you hold to your ear to hear the ocean, even far away from the sea?
en.hint: You find it on the beach.

en.q: What do you call a train that sneezes?
en.hint: Say choo-choo with a sneeze.

en.q: Which letter of the alphabet is a drink?
en.hint: People drink it with honey and lemon.

en.q: I am full of water and you jump into me on a hot day. What am I?
en.hint: Don't forget your goggles!

en.q: I ring loudly every morning to wake you up. What am I?
en.hint: You can press my snooze button.
